tools.name: grant_search
tools.description: FREE. Open and forecasted US federal grants matching a keyword (e.g. 'broadband', 'small business', 'opioid') — top 3.

tools.name: grant_search_full
tools.description: PRO. Up to 100 grants for several keywords with agency code and eligibility filters (e.g. eligibilities '12' nonprofits, '23' small business, '25' others).

tools.name: closing_soon
tools.description: PRO. Posted grants for your keywords closing within N days (default 30), soonest first.
